issues.quote: would that hand unclench its iron fingers, or would it release me?
How I used to wait for them at times!
one acquaintance, a lady, had been ailing with her heart for fifteen years
I would shudder when I heard a human shadow behind me, and I listened
roaring torrents of human life rushing toward me like wild horses

strengths.quote: I have grown sick of being a coaching inn where those creatures forever jostle, shout, bustle about and foul the place.
that beautiful brother of death came and took me to himself
would the iron hand clatter its bones in vain?
petty, unnecessary words, like chips and straw on spring torrents
My heart can hold no more. It is full to the brim. Give me peace…
